verdict.rationale: Requesty is an API/gateway product accessed via standard OpenAI-compatible HTTP calls, which is inherently scriptable, and it explicitly supports service accounts (non-human entities not tied to a user) and per-key spend caps — both features clearly aimed at automated/CI-style usage. However, there is no explicit CI/CD documentation, example pipeline, or CLI/headless-mode guide demonstrating running Requesty in automation contexts. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration docs or examples, a dedicated CLI/headless mode, and any automation-specific tutorial beyond generic API/SDK usage.
